title: South Dakota Codified Laws Chapter 60-11 - Wages, Hours and Conditions of Employment
verified_how: fetched the register's own API for the Title (https://sdlegislature.gov/api/Statutes/Statute/60): CatchLine 'LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT', chapter index row '11 Wages, Hours And Conditions Of Employment' with no [Repealed] marker (siblings 60-6A, 60-6B and 60-7 do carry '[Repealed]' or '[Repealed And Transferred]', so the marker is in use on that index); then fetched https://sdlegislature.gov/api/Statutes/Statute/60-11, which returned Type 'Chapter', CatchLine 'WAGES, HOURS AND CONDITIONS OF EMPLOYMENT', Repealed false, sections running from 60-11-1. Currency from https://sdlegislature.gov/api/Statutes/LastStatuesEffectiveDate: 2026-09-03.
notes: Minimum wage, hours, pay periods, deductions and wage-payment duties. The general obligations of employer and employee sit in ch. 60-2 and wage claims against a terminated employee's employer in ch. 60-4; both verified in force on the same Title index but not listed because only one statute per topic is recorded.
